root_cause: Four workflow steps ran third-party actions (openai/codex-action, supabase/setup-cli) by moving tag (@v1) with repository secrets in scope. The action owner could change what runs without any change in this repository. 119 workflows use first-party actions by tag, which is accepted.

observed_evidence.source: audit of 123 workflow files on main 99fd28c on 2026-10-29

fix: Pin openai/codex-action to bdf19a4a (v1.13) and supabase/setup-cli to 1dedf2c6 (v1.7.3, current head of the v1 branch) with the version in a comment. Existing Dependabot github-actions updates keep the pins current. tests/brain-third-party-actions-sha-pin-v1.test.mjs fails any new third-party action that is not pinned to a 40-character commit.
prevention_rule: Third-party actions are pinned to a commit SHA with the version in a comment. First-party actions/* and github/* may use version tags.
correction_of_earlier_statement: The change note of 2026-10-28 (blog-reader-brief-guard) says the blog of 2026-10-25 is live with internal wording. A source check on 2026-10-29 shows the live page contains none of the internal terms and has a reader-facing title; only its URL slug is meta. No page was changed.

invariants: third-party actions are pinned to a 40-character commit
no workflow behaviour changes: same action code as the moving tags pointed to on 2026-10-29
